summary: BioMar has appointed a new expert in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) technology. The hiring reflects the company's focus on advanced aquaculture feed solutions for closed-system farming environments.
title: Ny RAS-ekspert i Biomar

summary: The article covers the progress of Patagonic's RAS (recirculation aquaculture system) facility that incorporates BioMar feed technology for land-based salmon farming. The development demonstrates rapid advancement in terrestrial salmon cultivation methods using BioMar's aquaculture feed solutions.
title: Patagonic RAS Biomar: Cultivo de salmón en tierra avanza a pasos agigantados
title_en: Patagonic RAS Biomar: Cultivo de salmón en tierra avanza a pasos agigantados

summary: BioMar and Chinese feed producer Tongwei have announced the opening of a joint venture to produce aquaculture feed in China. The partnership represents BioMar's expansion into the Chinese market through a strategic collaboration with a major local feed producer.
title: BioMar-Tongwei open Chinese aquafeed JV

summary: BioMar and Skretting have rejected a formal demand from Chile's competition authority (FNE) related to an investigation into alleged collusion between the two aquaculture feed suppliers. The legal challenge centers on competition concerns in the salmon feed market.
title: BioMar y Skretting rechazan requerimiento de FNE por eventual colusión
title_en: BioMar y Skretting rechazan requerimiento de FNE por eventual colusión
